High Court Stays Ruling on Chandigarh Golf Club's RTI Status

The Chhattisgarh High Court has modified a previous judgment concerning the Right to Information (RTI) Act. The court substituted specific terms like 'bombarded' and 'habitual information seeker' in its ruling. Separately, the High Court has stayed a ruling that declared the Chandigarh Golf Club a public authority under the RTI Act.
